topic_coverage.quoted_user_text: OpenCode on Linux does not offer/recognize any its-magic slash commands (/auto, /intake, etc.) even though files exist under .opencode/commands/.
Proven on root@docker-dmz project strategy_trading_bot: file .opencode/commands/auto.md shows ASCII text with CRLF line terminators; od -c shows CR LF after --- and every frontmatter line.

Same failure class as BUG-0008 (CRLF breaking Linux consumers). .gitattributes currently only forces LF for *.sh and *.manifest, NOT .opencode/**/*.md. Agents/plugin also CRLF in kit checkout. Windows often still works.

Distinct from BUG-0015 (plugin dispatch attach) DONE and BUG-0016 (Layer-1 permissions) DONE. Fix should LF-normalize OpenCode command/agent/plugin markdown (gitattributes and/or publish guards) so YAML frontmatter parses on Linux.

Done when Linux OpenCode lists and recognizes /auto, /intake, and peer slash commands from .opencode/commands/*.md (LF or equivalent defensive parse), with contract/gitattributes/parity checks proving no CRLF in shipped OpenCode markdown.

duplicate_check_notes: Distinct from BUG-0008 (installer manifest CRLF), BUG-0015 DONE (plugin dispatch), BUG-0016 DONE (Layer-1 permissions). Same CRLF failure class as BUG-0008 but different consumer: OpenCode YAML frontmatter for slash commands under .opencode/commands/.
decomposition_rationale: Bounded defect: line-ending normalization for OpenCode pack markdown so Linux OpenCode loads slash commands. Single independently testable vertical slice; no feature split needed.
